metadata.name: Dimensional Workflow Hero
metadata.description: A responsive GSAP hero with a fanned 3D deck, scroll-driven workflow chapters and custom React scenes. Includes phone layouts, chapter navigation, semantic light and dark themes, and a reduced-motion reading layout. Copy and visuals are supplied through props.
metadata.author: automate_flows
